def calculate_match_score(candidate_skills, interviewer_skills):
    score = 0
    total_possible = 0
    
    # Check language matches
    candidate_languages = set(candidate_skills['languages'])
    interviewer_languages = set([skill.lower() for skill in interviewer_skills if any(lang in skill.lower() for lang in ['python', 'java', 'javascript', 'c++', 'go', 'node.js'])])
